#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cap-air sensitivity (jet-2026-10-15 addendum): only C38-C41's body-to-air sees air warmer than the bay.

A TopRegion of zero board area (xy -1000..-999) at h_top = the case h (10), credit_refs C38-C41, t_air_rise = dT: the
board's top cells are untouched; the four cap bodies convect at h 10 to air at bay + dT. Solved exactly as run_basis.one
(same heat file construction, FET tab ties, I_line), at 0.25 and 0.5 mm; rows from b3_ratings_gate.evaluate.
    python3 cap_air.py [--workers 4]   -> cap-air.json next to the study README (rows), runs here
"""
import json
import sys
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
B3R = HERE.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(B3R))
import run_basis as rb  # noqa: E402

gate, br, tb, rs, fet_case = rb.gate, rb.br, rb.tb, rb.rs, rb.fet_case
CAPS = ("C38", "C39", "C40", "C41")
JOBS = [("c18_h10", 61.0, dt) for dt in (5.0, 10.0, 15.0)] + [("c22_h10", 55.0, 10.0)]
OUT = B3R / "jet-2026-10-15/cap-air.json"


def tag(case, bay, dt):
    return f"{case}_bay{int(bay)}_capair{int(dt)}"


def one(job):
    case, bay, dt, pitch = job
    ceil, h = gate.case_ceiling_h(case)
    op = case.split("_")[0]
    c = rb.inputs(op, ceil, HERE)
    br.op_inputs = lambda _op, _c=c: _c
    brd = tb.Board(rs.GEOM, rb.RUNS / "cache")
    leads = {"pad": "2", "g": rb.LEAD_G,
             "t_rise": {r: t - bay for r, t in fet_case.t_case(ceil, i_line=rb.I_LINE_A).items()}}
    region = tb.TopRegion((-1000.0, -999.0, -1000.0, -999.0), float(h), dt, name="cap_air", credit_refs=CAPS)
    res = br.run_case(brd, op, h, pitch, "fraction", "network", {}, None, None, True, True,
                      label=tag(case, bay, dt), leads=leads, region=region)
    res["board_sha256"] = brd.data["board_sha256"]
    res.update(bay_c=bay, i_line_a=rb.I_LINE_A, i_t_a=rb.i_trip(ceil), ceiling_a=ceil)
    assert res["region"]["region_cells_top"] == 0 and res["region"]["body_air_credited"] == list(CAPS)
    name = f"{tag(case, bay, dt)}_p{str(pitch).replace('.', 'p')}"
    (HERE / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps(res, indent=1) + "\n")
    return name


def rows(r25, r05, bay):
    keep = ("R10: 2512 terminal", "R20: 2512 terminal", "R12: 2512 terminal", "C40:", "C38:", "laminate")
    ev = gate.evaluate(r25, r05, bay)
    return ({r["item"]: r["margin_k"] for r in ev if r["item"].startswith(keep)},
            min(r["margin_k"] for r in ev if r["gated"]), min((r for r in ev if r["gated"]), key=lambda r: r["margin_k"])["item"])


def main():
    import argparse
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=4)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    jobs = [(c, b, d, p) for c, b, d in JOBS for p in (0.25, 0.5)]
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(a.workers, 4)) as ex:
        for n in ex.map(one, jobs):
            print("  solved", n, flush=True)
    out = {"scope": __doc__.strip(), "script": Path(__file__).read_text(), "cases": {}}
    ld = B3R / "runs/control-lead-only"
    for case, bay in (("c18_h10", 61.0), ("c22_h10", 55.0)):
        r25, r05 = (json.loads((ld / f"{case}_p{p}.json").read_text()) for p in ("0p25", "0p5"))
        sel, worst, wi = rows(r25, r05, bay)
        out["cases"][f"{case}@{bay:g} lead-only (floor)"] = {"rows": sel, "worst_gated_margin_k": worst, "worst": wi,
                                                              "pass": worst >= 0}
        r25, r05 = (json.loads((B3R / f"runs/{case}_p{p}.json").read_text()) for p in ("0p25", "0p5"))
        sel, worst, wi = rows(r25, r05, bay)
        out["cases"][f"{case}@{bay:g} cap air +0 K (margins.json)"] = {"rows": sel, "worst_gated_margin_k": worst,
                                                                       "worst": wi, "pass": worst >= 0}
    for case, bay, dt in JOBS:
        r25, r05 = (json.loads((HERE / f"{tag(case, bay, dt)}_p{p}.json").read_text()) for p in ("0p25", "0p5"))
        sel, worst, wi = rows(r25, r05, bay)
        caps_w = sum(p["body_air_w"] for p in r25["parts"] if p["ref"] in CAPS)
        out["cases"][f"{case}@{bay:g} cap air +{dt:g} K"] = {"rows": sel, "worst_gated_margin_k": worst, "worst": wi,
                                                             "pass": worst >= 0, "caps_body_air_w_p0p25": round(caps_w, 3),
                                                             "balance_rel": r25["balance"]["balance_rel"]}
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1) + "\n")
    for k, v in out["cases"].items():
        print(k, "PASS" if v["pass"] else "FAIL", v["worst_gated_margin_k"], v["worst"][:30], v["rows"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
